QuestInfo.name: [9th Anniversary Par-tayt] Hanging the Banner
QuestInfo.0: Put up the banner made to celebrate the Maple 9th Anniversary party.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the 9th Anniversary Commemorative Park and break the boxes scattered about with a normal attack. Then you'll be able to collect the necessary materials hang a banner. Collect all the materials and bring them to Cassandra.
QuestInfo.2: Phew. The banner's up. The party's getting close to being ready. right?

default.0: You still haven't collected all the Lightweight Tree Branches that you need, have you?

npc.0: Go talk to Inkie at the 9th Anniversary Park. You can use the Dimensional Mirror or the Teleport Rock that I gave you.
